draft.body:
## Summary

Excessive ads for free users

## Evidence

> Great for music but needs less ads. If only they had less ads or no ads it would be perfect.
> — review `14625148881`, 2026-10-04, 4★, v9.1.88

> Good but bad. This is a great app but there is one thing there are commercials after everything song
> — review `14625038465`, 2026-10-04, 2★, v9.1.88

## Suspected area

Not clear from the reviews.

## Affected versions and devices

- App versions (from the store): 9.1.88
- Devices / OS mentioned: none mentioned

## Severity

3/5 (moderate), 2 review(s) in theme “Request for fewer advertisements”.

---
Proposed by Review Radar from Spotify: Music and Podcasts App Store reviews and approved by an operator. Quotes are verbatim from public reviews.
